articles.title: Altcoin selling tops $266B as capital rotates out of crypto: Is altseason extinct?
articles.snippet: Altcoin spot demand fell to its weakest level in six years while the stablecoin market cap, stocks and AI industry continued to capture investors’ attention.

articles.title: Trace Finance raises $32M for cross-border stablecoin settlement expansion
articles.snippet: The raise comes as stablecoin regulation advances globally and financial firms invest in infrastructure connecting blockchain payments with traditional banking systems.

articles.title: China pays closer attention to stablecoins as cross-border role expands
articles.snippet: A senior PBOC official called for closer monitoring, stronger regulation and international coordination as stablecoins gain importance in global payments.

articles.title: Senators urge Treasury to ensure state authority in GENIUS application
articles.snippet: A bipartisan group of US senators told the Treasury that its application of stablecoin laws should be done in a way that “preserves and promotes State participation.”

articles.title: State Street launches GENIUS Act-aligned money market fund for stablecoin reserves
articles.snippet: The launch comes amid growing competition among financial institutions to manage assets backing dollar-pegged stablecoins.
